action: Side view of a half-court scene. The attacker stands in the left third of the canvas with the basketball held at chest level; the defender stands in the middle third between the attacker and the hoop, arms raised. The attacker takes one step forward, rises onto his toes, and releases a jump shot over the defender's outstretched arm — the release is a contact beat interpolation cannot invent. The ball then arcs high across the middle lane and drops through the hoop mounted on a pole at the right edge, above head height. The defender stays grounded, only shifting weight and turning slightly. Head sizes, builds, and limb lengths stay identical on every key; only poses and the ball's position change.
layout_notes: attacker in left third, defender in middle third, hoop and pole at right edge with rim above head height; ball's flight lane is the open space above and between the two figures; shared ground line across the bottom quarter; figures about one quarter of the canvas tall

parts.name: attacker_head
parts.notes: same size circle on every key; rises with the jump

parts.name: attacker_torso
parts.notes: same length; leans slightly into the shot then straightens

parts.name: attacker_arms
parts.notes: chest hold, then both arms extend up and forward for the release

parts.name: attacker_legs
parts.notes: step then bent knees extending into a jump

parts.name: defender_head
parts.notes: same size circle, unchanging size; tilts up to watch the ball

parts.name: defender_torso
parts.notes: same length; slight weight shift only, stays grounded

parts.name: defender_arms
parts.notes: raise from sides to straight up contesting the shot

parts.name: defender_legs
parts.notes: planted feet, slight bend for the weight shift

parts.name: basketball
parts.notes: small circle smaller than a head; travels from hands to hoop

parts.name: hoop_and_pole
parts.how: vertical pole line plus short rim line
parts.notes: exact same points every key; rim above head height at right edge

parts.name: ground
parts.notes: one shared ground line across the bottom, identical every key

keys.name: start
keys.notes: attacker in left third holding ball at chest, knees slightly bent facing right; defender in middle third facing left with arms half raised; hoop at right edge

keys.name: release
keys.notes: attacker up on toes, both arms extended up and forward, ball just leaving fingertips at top of reach; defender fully extended arms straight up, head tilted to ball

keys.name: score
keys.notes: ball dropping through the rim at the right edge; attacker landed, arms following through wrists down; defender turned watching, weight settled back

gaps.why: step-up and lift into the release; moderate travel of arms and body, smooth rise
longest travel: the ball arcs across the middle lane to the hoop, plus the attacker's follow-through and landing; same ease as the rise so speed does not flip
